cutover_decisions.subject: edge vs evidence public naming
cutover_decisions.decision: Use `canon entity evidence` as the final public v1 scoring stage. Do not keep `canon entity edge` as a compatibility alias.
acceptance_criteria: bd-h9jn removes the public `canon entity edge` leaf while preserving internal edge-record implementation names only where they are not public contract text.
bd-h9jn exposes `canon entity evidence` in Clap help, subprocess smoke tests, dispatch request typing, and operator/help fixtures.
v1 solve/run artifact metadata references `canon_entity_evidence.v1`; legacy `canon_entity_edge.v0` is accepted only as a compatibility-firewall input that produces an actionable refusal.

cutover_decisions.subject: v0 legacy refusal vs v1 artifact emission path
cutover_decisions.decision: Public entity commands emit v1 artifacts only after bd-h9jn. Legacy v0 entity artifacts and the old no-profile/no-work-dir run path become structured-refusal inputs, not alternate emission paths.
acceptance_criteria: `canon entity run` no longer selects a legacy engine from omitted `--profile`/`--work-dir`; it either compiles an explicit project/run request or refuses with the shared entity refusal envelope.
Each stage validates consumed artifact versions through the v1 compatibility firewall and returns `E_ENTITY_ARTIFACT_CONTRACT` with a concrete rerun command for stale v0 artifacts.
No public command emits `canon_entity_*.v0` artifacts after the scaffold cutover.

cutover_decisions.subject: prepare/profile public commands
cutover_decisions.decision: `canon entity prepare`, `canon entity profile list`, and `canon entity profile init` remain public commands. Entity operator metadata should use one row per public entity leaf.
acceptance_criteria: bd-h9jn keeps prepare/profile leaves in Clap and covers them in help/smoke tests.
operator.json granularity for entity uses one row per public leaf, including prepare/profile/link/evidence; doctor grouping is not precedent for hiding entity leaves.
No final public entity leaf depends on implicit domain defaults such as org, BDC, or CMBS-specific wording.
Agent Mail reserves exactly the listed paths before editing; no directory reservations or extra files without a prior coordination update.
Final public grammar includes `prepare`, `index build`, `block`, `evidence`, `solve`, `run`, `review`, `audit`, `promote`, `apply`, `explain`, and `link` with no `edge` alias.
`canon entity link <REFERENCE> <TARGET>` compiles to the same typed request/artifact family as the equivalent project manifest.
Run/project and explicit stage execution share typed request boundaries and emit/refuse through the same routing code.
Legacy v0 entity artifacts and omitted-profile legacy dispatch produce actionable structured refusals instead of v0 output.
Help and smoke fixtures contain no org wording, ambiguous engine switch, or domain-specific defaults.
